audience_definition.industry: AI agent evaluation, observability, and agent-security tooling
audience_definition.inclusion_rule: Company or the named individual has published a dated, publicly verifiable statement (blog post, press quote, or company research writeup) about AI agent reliability, agent failure modes, or agent security within the last 120 days, with a source URL that resolves and is directly attributable.
exclusion_rule: Company has been acquired by an organization with >1000 employees within the last 12 months
No verifiable, dated, publicly-sourced hook could be found for the named individual or their company
The named individual or their domain is present in the suppression ledger (suppression=true)
Role title falls outside the CEO/Founder/Co-Founder/CTO/Co-CEO decision-maker set
No real, verified email address exists for the named individual (email_verification_status != valid)

opt_out_language: If you'd rather not hear from me again, reply STOP and I will not contact you further.

success_metric.name: substantive_reply_rate
success_metric.target: >=1 substantive reply (not opt-out, not bounce, not auto-reply) among the initial 8-prospect send
success_metric.measured_by: manual classification of inbound replies against reply_policy, logged to a lane_returns-style receipt row per reply

failure_escalation.trigger: bounce rate exceeds 5% in a calendar day, OR any spam complaint is received, OR SPF/DKIM/DMARC authentication check fails, OR an opt-out is not honored within 10 business days
failure_escalation.action: immediately run `python kill_switch.py halt ARG-C1 --reason "<trigger observed>" --by "<who/what detected it>"`, stop all further sends under this authorization, and route to the operator for review before re-arming

sender_identity.physical_postal_address: UNVERIFIED — no valid business postal address is on file for this campaign. CAN-SPAM requires one in every commercial email. This authorization must not be treated as send-ready until the operator supplies a real address and this field is updated.
